entities.summary: Dominique-Marie Jean Michel David is a French prelate of the Catholic Church who has been the Archbishop of Monaco since 2021. He is a member of the Emmanuel Community. Dominique-Marie David was a religious figures from Beaupréau (b. 1963-09-21, Beaupréau). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
